lastCompletedStory.title: Leitura do event log limitada pela sessao dentro do produtor

nextStoryContext: readSnapshot now reads cam-worker-events.jsonl once per poll through EventLogReader, sharing the bounded body between Recent Progress and session token summation. A valid sidecar marker scans backwards to the earliest in-session event plus a 64 KiB physical-order margin; a missing or invalid marker uses a fixed 320 KiB tail. startWebServer threads the optional eventLogReader seam only into this event-log path, leaving transcript reads outside route byte measurement.

officialDocsValidated.summary: The story uses only the Node.js synchronous filesystem API already available in the runtime; no external library was exercised.
